label: Finding-54
title: more-paths: Missing context: the fix removed the OOM bailout itself, not only the demonstrated paths
description: The fix commit replaces bailout on OOM with UnwindExit and GHSA-w8hw says 'The patch removes longjmp() for OOM'. Fastly's point still applies to bailout on other fatal conditions (timeouts, uncaught errors), which GHSA-6wmf calls 'conditional', but a reader could take the claim to mean PHP only patched the demonstrated paths. Say which bailouts remain.
